Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets

Class MenuItem

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets.MenuItem
@BeanType(properties="id,label,icon,href,safe,divider") public class MenuItem extends Object
A single row in an attached header or avatar menu.

A menu item is exactly one of a link (same-origin navigation), a safe (format-validated client-event token, host-interpreted), or a divider (a separator row). Dividers are exempt from the id/label/href/ safe rules entirely: a fail-closed validate must not reject a real menu just because it contains a separator, and divider() mints no id.

Since:
10.0.0

    • link

      public static MenuItem link(String id, String label, String href)
      Creates a navigation (link) menu item.
      Parameters:
      id - The stable item id. Must not be null or blank.
      label - The row text. Must not be null or blank.
      href - The same-origin navigation target. Must not be null or blank.
      Returns:
      A new MenuItem.

    • safe

      public static MenuItem safe(String id, String label, String safeToken)
      Creates a client-safe menu item.
      Parameters:
      id - The stable item id. Must not be null or blank.
      label - The row text. Must not be null or blank.
      safeToken - The client-event token; must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$.
      Returns:
      A new MenuItem.

      Creates a divider (separator) row. Needs no id — it is exempt from the unique-id rule.

    • validate

      public void validate()
      Fail-closed bean validation; called by the enclosing menu host.

      Dividers are exempt: a divider validates trivially regardless of its other (ignored) fields.

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If this menu item is not well-formed.
